name: recovery-code
title: Recovery code
description: A player's way back to their progress on another device, in two presentations. `show` displays a code the host has just issued, once and large, with Copy, a Share that appears only where a share sheet exists, and the two warnings a player needs: keep it private, and a new code stops this one working. `enter` is the field a returning player types it into: a word keyboard, any case, spaces or hyphens, nothing autofilled or corrected, and the code handed to the host normalised. It issues, stores and checks nothing: the host calls its own API and passes a refusal back as `invalid` with its own sentence. Not `code-entry`, which is one digit per box on a numeric keypad.
docs: Issue the code in your own API and pass it as `code` with `presentation="show"`; show it once. For a returning player, render `presentation="enter"` and restore from `onSubmit`, which receives the code normalised (`normaliseRecoveryCode`). Set `busy` while your call is in flight, and `invalid` with `reason` when it refuses. On Gamestage: `game.client.issueRecoveryCode()`, `game.client.restoreFromRecoveryCode(code)` and `game.client.getRecoveryStatus()`. Pass `onCopy` or `onShare` to replace the browser clipboard or share sheet.
